'''Tiplee''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]. She often fought alongside her twin sister, [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]]. Throughout the war, she was sent with her sister and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to the planet [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]], where Tiplar was shot by [[Tup]] in a battle between her troops and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Skywalker and Tiplee then tried to find out the cause of the clone's misconduct. Some time later Tiplee traveled with three other Jedi to the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where they searched for clues to the whereabouts of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. She then led the search for Maul, along with Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] outpost where they found the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]. Darth Maul received support from [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and involved the Jedi in a fight in which Tiplee was killed.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|We're ''late'' already.''"<br />"''All right, I'm coming. It's just that, I ''sense'' something&hellip; a ''darkness''.''"<br />"''It is your imagination, playing tricks I think. This is the ''Jedi Temple'', remember? Bright center of the universe.|Tiplee and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TOP">{{SWComicCite|7.9|Temple of Phantoms}}</ref>}}
A [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="TU" /> of a [[Unidentified head-tendril species|humanoid species]],<ref name="TUGuide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-episode-guide|text="The Unknown" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Tiplee lived during the [[Rise of the Empire era]]. Being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], she was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] along with [[Tiplar/Legends|her sister]] to be trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Tiplee attended a lesson given by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]]. The training session was interrupted when [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was apparently [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] by [[Unidentified dark side entity|someone]] he couldn't see.<ref name="TOP" /> Sometime after, Tiplee and her sister [[Jedi Trial|attained]]<ref name="TU" /> the rank of Jedi Master.<ref name="TUGuide" /> She wielded a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TU" />

===Jedi Master===
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|erupted]], with the Jedi becoming the leaders of the newly created [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], as part of the Republic's pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war effort against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Along with all Jedi, Tiplee and Tiplar became [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]]<ref name="TU" /> and took [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone commander]] [[Doom/Legends|Doom]]<ref name="TUGuide" /> as their clone commander.<ref name="TU" />

===Ringo Vinda===
In c. [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> in an effort to relieve the ring space station in [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda's]] orbital station, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, Tiplar and Tiplee led the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] against the [[Battle droid/Legends|droid force]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] aboard the station. After several rotations, they reached<ref name="TU" /> the communication center<ref name="TUGuide" /> and captured it. Their next plan was to conquer the command center. But when they prepare to start the offensive, [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|CT-5385]], nicknamed "Tup", had been plagued by strange mental disorders which left him temporarily confused.<ref name="TU" />
[[File:TipleeMournsTiplar-TU.png|thumb|left|250px|Tiplee cradles her sister's body.]]
When the Jedi and clone forces fought their way into the station's command center, Tup suddenly went into some form of trance. Upon seeing Tiplar while in one of those blackouts, Tup unexpectedly snuck up on her and killed her with a blaster shot to her head. Tiplee witnessed the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her sister. After retreating back to base, Tiplee knelt by Tiplar's body, mourning her sister. While Skywalker interrogated Tup, Tiplee came to observe, standing in the doorway. Tup noticed her watching him and tried to attack her despite being restrained in binders. She quickly stopped him in his tracks by using the Force to lift him up and held him against the wall until he calmed down. She initially showed anger towards him, as he had killed her sister, but at a nod from Skywalker, she controlled herself and let him down. Afterwards, the Republic forces were forced to withdraw and Tup was sent to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="TU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tiplee's design, alongside that of her sister Tiplar, was based on concept art for a female Sith that was cut from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="TUGuide" />

In one scene of "[[The Unknown]]," the "hair" of Tiplee's 3-D model can be seen vanishing into the wall behind her head, one of the rare rendering glitches of the series.
